name: Reactive
new_capability: Executes explicit instructions and bounded operations.
certification_rule: Pass U0 suite at declared reliability and resource envelope.

name: Persistent
new_capability: Maintains persistent task/self state across turns or restarts and completes small delegated goals.
certification_rule: Retain U0 and pass persistence/restart tests without hidden human repair.

name: Adaptive
new_capability: Learns from experience and completes multi-step delegated tasks.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U1; demonstrate measurable transfer from experience under frozen tests.

name: Self-Improving
new_capability: Chooses strategy independently and performs governed improvement of cognitive/organizational mechanisms.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U2; improvement must beat frozen baseline without agent-controlled verifier/promotion.

name: Recursive
new_capability: Improves the improvement process and autonomously manages difficult long-horizon projects.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U3; show validated improvement in improvement competence across independent episodes.

name: Discovery
new_capability: Autonomously discovers previously unknown solution methods or knowledge from evidence.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U4; discovery must be externally verifiable and not present in supplied task instructions.

name: Mission Autonomous
new_capability: Turns a mission into goals, projects and tasks and manages them autonomously.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U5; complete mission outcomes while generating the necessary intermediate projects/tasks.

name: Open-Ended
new_capability: Under a bounded charter, identifies worthwhile missions and expands its future cognitive/organizational reach.
certification_rule: Retain U0-U6 across repeated cycles; new missions/capabilities must be externally validated and provenance-linked.
